description.en: Ends a match-side cutscene started with StartScEvent, if a match is currently active: on the upper display side, swaps the technique map back for the normal match map and deletes the temporary goal model, then clears the active-event state.
Whether the cutscene ran on the "upper" display side.
The [normalMapHandle, wazaMapHandle, goalModelHandle] array filled by StartScEvent.
No explicit return statement (an early `return;` with no value when no match is active) — implicitly null.
